title: The Rule That Needed an Appeal
title_ja: 異議申立てが必要だったルール
fact_notes: 人物・具体的な出来事・制度は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計・法律・医療指示を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: The council of an imaginary town introduced a new rule for reserving rooms in its community center.
sentences.ja: 架空の町の議会は地域センターの部屋を予約する新しい規則を導入した。

sentences.en: Under the rule, groups that repeatedly failed to use their reserved rooms would temporarily lose booking privileges.
sentences.ja: 規則の下で予約した部屋を繰り返し使用しない団体は一時的に予約権を失うことになった。

sentences.en: The council hoped to increase the availability of rooms for residents who had previously been unable to reserve them.
sentences.ja: 議会はこれまで予約できなかった住民が部屋を利用できる機会を増やしたかった。

sentences.en: Initially, the rule seemed straightforward because the center kept a record of all reservations.
sentences.ja: センターに全予約の記録があったため、当初規則は単純に見えた。

sentences.en: However, one volunteer group received a notice that its privileges had been suspended despite attending every scheduled meeting.
sentences.ja: しかしあるボランティア団体は予定された会議にすべて参加したのに予約権が停止されたという通知を受けた。

sentences.en: A staff member had accidentally recorded the group as absent when it had used a different room with permission.
sentences.ja: 団体が許可を得て別室を使った際、職員が誤って欠席と記録していた。

sentences.en: The group contacted the center, but the staff initially had no established procedure for reviewing such a decision.
sentences.ja: 団体はセンターに連絡したが、職員にはそのような決定を再検討する確立した手続きがなかった。

sentences.en: The problem revealed a weakness in the administration of the rule rather than a disagreement about its original purpose.
sentences.ja: 問題は元の目的への反対ではなく規則の運用上の弱点を明らかにした。

sentences.en: The council invited several residents and staff members to discuss possible changes to the booking system.
sentences.ja: 議会は住民と職員数名を招き予約制度の変更案を話し合った。

sentences.en: Participants agreed that records were necessary but that the people affected by a decision should also have an opportunity to challenge incorrect information.
sentences.ja: 参加者は記録が必要である一方、決定の影響を受ける人にも誤情報に異議を申し立てる機会が必要だと合意した。

sentences.en: They proposed providing a written explanation whenever a group's booking privileges were restricted, along with clear instructions for requesting a review.
sentences.ja: 予約権が制限される際は書面の説明と再検討を求める明確な手順を提供することを提案した。

sentences.en: They also suggested that the person responsible for reviewing the complaint should not be the person who made the initial decision.
sentences.ja: 申し立てを再検討する人は当初の決定者と別であるべきだと提案した。

sentences.en: Before putting the revised procedure into effect, the council considered whether residents would be able to use it without specialized knowledge.
sentences.ja: 修正手続きの施行前、議会は住民が専門知識なしに利用できるか考えた。

sentences.en: They prepared a short application form and offered assistance to residents who had difficulty completing it.
sentences.ja: 短い申請書を作り、記入に困難のある住民を支援することにした。

sentences.en: The center also established a reasonable period for responding to requests so that complaints would not remain unresolved indefinitely.
sentences.ja: センターは申し立てが無期限に未解決にならないよう、対応のための合理的な期間も設定した。

sentences.en: The original group was eventually able to present its evidence and regain its privileges after the incorrect record was corrected.
sentences.ja: 当初の団体はついに証拠を提出し、誤記録が修正されて予約権を取り戻した。

sentences.en: The experience did not persuade the council to abandon the booking rule entirely, since its underlying objective remained important.
sentences.ja: 経験を通じても議会は予約規則そのものを廃止しなかった。根本の目的は依然重要だったからだ。

sentences.en: Rather, it highlighted the importance of designing fair procedures alongside the rules that govern access to shared public resources.
sentences.ja: むしろ公共の共有資源の利用を管理する規則とともに公正な手続きを設計する重要性を浮き彫りにした。

sentences.en: A rule may be reasonable in principle while its application produces an unfair result in a particular case.
sentences.ja: 原則として合理的な規則でも個別の場合には運用が不公平な結果を生むことがある。

sentences.en: For the council, improving fairness required both a legitimate objective and a practical way to identify and correct mistakes.
sentences.ja: 議会にとって公平性の向上には正当な目的と誤りを見つけ修正する実用的な方法の双方が必要だった。

vocabulary.definition: an established way of doing something
a statement that something is wrong
a document used to make a request
for an unknown length of time
a result one hopes to achieve
the act of putting something into use
the quality of treating people fairly

questions.prompt: What was the aim of the original rule?
options: Make rooms more available to residents.
questions.explanation_ja: 予約機会を増やす目的。

questions.prompt: Who would temporarily lose booking privileges?
options: Groups repeatedly failing to use reserved rooms.
questions.explanation_ja: 予約した部屋を繰り返し利用しない団体。

questions.prompt: Why was the volunteer group incorrectly penalized?
options: It had never received permission to meet.
A staff member had recorded it as absent by mistake.
It had deliberately ignored the rule.
It had destroyed the booking records.
questions.explanation_ja: 職員が誤って欠席と記録した。

questions.prompt: What weakness did the incident expose?
options: There was no established review procedure.
No rooms were available to any group.
The original goal had become unnecessary.
questions.explanation_ja: 再検討の手続きがなかった。

questions.prompt: What should accompany a restriction notice?
options: An explanation and instructions for requesting review.
An automatic refusal of all complaints.
A new fee for each meeting.
To remove all responsibility for record keeping.
To make the group prove every past reservation.
To prevent residents from receiving explanations.
To reduce the risk of simply repeating the initial decision without independent consideration.
questions.explanation_ja: 当初の決定と独立して再検討できる。

questions.prompt: What did the council provide to make review accessible?
options: A mandatory payment for every request.

questions.prompt: What happened to the volunteer group's privileges?
options: They were restored after the record was corrected.
They were sold to another group.
questions.explanation_ja: 記録修正後に回復した。

questions.prompt: What does legitimate mean in the final sentence?
Which principle is central to the passage?
options: A reasonable public rule also needs fair ways to review and correct its application.
Fairness requires eliminating all booking rules.
Accurate records make appeals unnecessary in every case.
A rule's purpose is irrelevant to its application.
questions.explanation_ja: 合理的規則にも公正な再検討・修正手続きが必要。

grammar.explanation_ja: wouldは過去から見た将来の結果を表す。

grammar.focus: the people affected by a decision
while its application produces an unfair result

paraphrases.source: Under the rule, groups that repeatedly failed to use their reserved rooms would temporarily lose booking privileges.
paraphrases.rewrite: Groups repeatedly missing reserved sessions would lose booking rights for a limited time.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 繰り返し未利用の団体は一時停止。

paraphrases.source: However, one volunteer group received a notice that its privileges had been suspended despite attending every scheduled meeting.
paraphrases.rewrite: One group was told that its privileges were suspended even though it had attended each planned meeting.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 会議参加にもかかわらず停止通知。

paraphrases.source: Participants agreed that records were necessary but that the people affected by a decision should also have an opportunity to challenge incorrect information.
paraphrases.rewrite: Participants believed that people whose rights were affected should be able to question inaccurate records.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 影響を受ける人に異議の機会。

paraphrases.source: A rule may be reasonable in principle while its application produces an unfair result in a particular case.
paraphrases.rewrite: Even a sound rule can be applied in a way that yields an unfair outcome in an individual situation.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 合理的規則でも個別の運用は不公平になり得る。

discourse.role_ja: 制度の想定と誤りを対比。
記録の必要性と異議の機会を併記。
対応期間を設ける目的。
規則の廃止ではなく手続き改善へ。

cloze.explanation_ja: 権利を制限するときの説明。
未解決のままになるのを防ぐ。
